label: Above detection range
description: The value was above the detection range of the instrument used to estimate it.

label: Below detection range
description: The value was below the detection range of the instrument used to estimate it.

label: Inapplicable
source: ISO 19136:2007 Geographic information - Geography Markup Language sub-clause 8.2.3.1

label: Missing
description: The correct value is not readily available to the sender of this data. Furthermore, a correct value may not exist.
source: ISO 19136:2007 Geographic information - Geography Markup Language sub-clause 8.2.3.1

label: No significant change
description: No significant change is expected to occur.

label: Nothing detected by automated system
description: The automated observing system did not detect a value (e.g. no cloud detected NCD).

label: Not observable
description: A system failure, sensor failure, or sensor obstruction, prevented the intended observation of the value.

label: Nothing of operational signficance
description: Nothing was observed or forecast of operational significance (e.g. nil significant cloud NSC, nil significant weather NSW).

label: Template
description: The value will be available later.
source: ISO 19136:2007 Geographic information - Geography Markup Language sub-clause 8.2.3.1

label: Unknown
description: The correct value is not known to, and not computable by, the sender of this data. However, a correct value probably exists.
source: ISO 19136:2007 Geographic information - Geography Markup Language sub-clause 8.2.3.1

label: Withheld
source: ISO 19136:2007 Geographic information - Geography Markup Language sub-clause 8.2.3.1
